process.title: 实现 nthprime.py 第 n 个素数及测试
process.scope: Owns only nthprime.py and tests/test_nthprime.py (new files only). Does not touch dijkstra, windscale, or any existing file; does not import other project modules.
process.task: Implement nthprime.py (standard library only, no imports of other project modules) and tests/test_nthprime.py as new files; do not modify any existing file. Spec (verbatim from work order): `nth_prime(n: int) -> int`：1 起数（第 1 个素数是 2）。n 须为 int（bool 拒），非 int 抛 TypeError；n < 1 抛 ValueError。 Acceptance examples (each must have a corresponding test case): `nth_prime(1) == 2`；`nth_prime(2) == 3`；`nth_prime(3) == 5`；`nth_prime(4) == 7`；`nth_prime(5) == 11`；`nth_prime(6) == 13`；`nth_prime(10) == 29`；`nth_prime(25) == 97`；`nth_prime(50) == 229`；`nth_prime(100) == 541`；`nth_prime(1000) == 7919`；`nth_prime(0)`、`nth_prime(-3)` 抛 ValueError；`nth_prime(2.0)`、`nth_prime("3")`、`nth_prime(True)` 抛 TypeError。 Cover every acceptance item with a test case.
